articles.summary: BRIDGEWATER N.J., Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Legend Biotech Corporation (NASDAQ: LEGN) ( Legend Biotech), a global leader in cell therapy, today announced that Alan Bash, interim Chief Executive Officer, will participate in a fireside chat at the Morgan Stanley Global Healthcare Conference
articles.title: Legend Biotech to Participate in the Morgan Stanley Global Healthcare Conference
